description: This file implements media fetching logic, including handling HTTP responses, error handling, content disposition parsing, MIME detection, and fetch retries with guards. It exports a main function 'fetchRemoteMedia' for fetching media resources with various options.

classes.name: MediaFetchError
classes.description: Custom error class for media fetch errors, includes an error code.

methods.name: fetchRemoteMedia
methods.description: Main function to fetch media from a remote URL with options for retries, size limits, and error handling.

methods.name: parseContentDispositionFileName
methods.description: Parses the Content-Disposition header to extract filename, handling encoded filenames.
